name: Cellebrite DI Ltd (Nasdaq, FPI)
verdict: FLAT — size zero; re-court only on dated triggers (below)
ruling: Both benches REJECT. The brief's two load-bearing legs died on primaries: (1) 'H2 bar = two-thirds of last year' divided organic guidance by a comparator carrying $16.1M of PURCHASED Corellium ARR (closed 12/1/25) — organic bar is 92-114% of last year, a repeat not a sandbag; (2) 'NRR up 2pts' is a sequential cherry-pick — YoY is 120->117, expansion eroding per management's own transcript. Blue then narrowed red's overreach: the organic growth step-down is ~2pts (17->15), not 21->15 — red applied its own Corellium correction asymmetrically — and 'no FY26 divergence' tested the wrong period (the de-rate prices FY27, which nobody tabled). Decisive sizing veto blue CLOSED: Sun Corp holds ~47% (~$1.25B) with ValueAct at 7.8% of Sun publicly pressing monetization — an undated, unsized control-block supply overhang with a live Form 144 cadence.

kills.kill: control_block_activist_monetization_overhang: Sun 47% + ValueAct pressing; undated supply, sizing veto independent of fundamentals
H1'26 FCF -34% YoY (12.3% margin vs marketed 28% TTM); cause undecomposed
CEO exit venue-divergence: 6-K 'mutual agreement... ceased serving' + same-day board exit vs PR 'planned succession'

reopen_triggers: Sun/CLBT structural resolution or marketed secondary with a clearing price (also the upside catalyst)
Q3'26 organic net-new ARR > $26M with NRR >= 118%
live IBKR print before any order stages
notes: Residual re-rate case (~2pt organic decel vs -47.7% drawdown) is genuinely untested — nobody produced street FY27. That is the re-court question, not a reason to own it unanchored.
